# Disposable ephemeral deletion fixture

Run `python3 packages/tests/fixtures/ephemeral-deletion-convex/run.py` only with ports 3540 and 3541 free. It starts a fresh loopback database, disables beacon and telemetry before synchronization, strips inherited provider variables, and stops only its own backend. It deploys the actual product schema and re-exports the registered product cleanup and guarded telemetry claim mutations; the public fixture bridge seeds synthetic data and invokes those mutations. A supplied user ID stands in for the production HTTP action’s verified session; no real authentication is tested. No provider or external service is contacted.

The test covers over 100 rows per table, concurrent calls, replay, request matching, transactional rollback, other-owner and anonymous identity retention, the global issuance bucket, billing attempts, compute debits, webhook deliveries, receipts, and the user record. A synthetic changed-request test checks progress cannot carry over to a different request. It does not delete financial records or prove whole-account erasure. With the product telemetry fence integrated, it also checks concurrent pending-owner claims, anonymous attachment denial, and post-completion claim denial without changing the issuance bucket. It cannot attribute anonymous identities or prove behavior of real authentication or telemetry delivery.
